payload.description:
## Context

When a commit or push hook runs pyright and projection-skills in the same run, I want projection-skills to judge only files that stay, so a hook run does not refuse itself at random. On 2026-11-13 it refused twice during basicly-p71af3r: once at a lane commit and once at the push of main fb5ed616, each time with .agents/skills/basicly-pyright-<random>.json listed as unmanaged. The file was gone right after, and an unchanged retry passed. The pyright check writes its temporary config into .agents/skills while projection-skills scans that folder.
payload.title: projection-skills refuses a temporary pyright file that a parallel hook check writes
